problem_semantics.objective: maximize joint-direction-speed expected farm power in kW
problem_semantics.wake_model: archived Jensen/Park top-hat wake with root-sum-square superposition
problem_semantics.power_curve: legacy 629.1-kW synthetic curve, including zero power at 18 m/s
problem_semantics.physical_evaluation: one completed full-layout evaluation over the complete frozen wind distribution
problem_semantics.terminal_rule: retain each completed candidate and stop before the next unevaluated candidate

algorithm_identity: corresponding original paper's explicit equations, pseudocode, stages and parameters
archived author or project MATLAB source for details omitted by the paper
pre-registered explicit reconstruction when both are silent
problem_identity: FODE comparison paper and frozen case contract
shared C++ implementation after cross-language numeric validation

fode.state_semantics: archived executable FODE state machine under exact physical-FES stopping
fode.parallel_semantics: generation snapshot, independent trial construction and evaluation, deterministic selection/archive/memory merge

aga.state_semantics: paper Steps 1-6 with source-completed selection, crossover, effective mutation threshold and one worst-turbine relocation per parent
aga.parallel_semantics: independent parent relocation and population evaluation; deterministic ordered genetic merge

sugga.state_semantics: AGA state machine plus paper SVR-guided or random worst-turbine relocation using frozen case-specific models
sugga.parallel_semantics: independent per-parent surrogate candidate scoring and population evaluation; deterministic ordered genetic merge

ise.state_semantics: paper Algorithm 1 and Eq. 17 on a round(D/3) reduced coordinate subset
ise.parallel_semantics: read-only parent generation snapshot, independent offspring construction/evaluation and indexed parent-child merge
ise.legacy_label_policy: LSE is accepted only by historical readers and is rejected by the new CLI

agpso.state_semantics: paper Algorithm 1 staged synchronous update with Eq. 21 no-inertia velocity and lines 40-43 conditional population survival
agpso.parallel_semantics: parallel within elite generation, adaptive replacement, velocity-position update and evaluation; barrier between paper stages

cgpso.state_semantics: paper Algorithm 1 staged synchronous PSO with Eq. 16 SS-1D search and Eqs. 17-20 CLS-M success/failure map memory
cgpso.parallel_semantics: complete CLS first, then parallel exemplar generation, position update and evaluation with deterministic stage barriers

lshade.state_semantics: L-SHADE Algorithm 2 with SHADE success-history parameter adaptation and linear population reduction
lshade.parallel_semantics: independent parameter sampling, mutation, crossover, repair and evaluation; deterministic archive, memory and reduction merge

clshade.state_semantics: paper-derived CLSHADE equations and Algorithm 1 with L=50 success/failure map memory and registered r0=0.01 reconstruction
clshade.parallel_semantics: parallel L-SHADE offspring batch, then ordered one-candidate chaotic local search and deterministic memory update
